messages:
alex: FYI customer AcmeRetail (ticket 7892) reports streaming JSON gets truncated mid-stream when they rotate auth tokens on their side. Client error: 'unexpected end of JSON input'. They can repro ~1/100 long streams.
jordan: any chance this is a proxy/timeout vs auth rotate?
alex: attached proxy logs show upstream 502 then conn close around the same time as their token rotate event. req=abcd1234 stream=stream-7892
acme_dev: confirming — we reproduced locally by forcing a token rotate during a long SSE stream. client gets partial JSON and parse error. stack trace attached.
maya_oncall: pinging eng-runtime — could token refresh trigger a backend 4xx that tears down active SSEs? @sam_runtime
sam_runtime: digging in. the customer is using structured-output (json mode) over SSE. I see our auth middleware returns 401/403 on invalid tokens and then we close the connection. that will definitely leave a partial payload if it happens mid-chunk.
eli_sre: corroborating — TLS session teardown events line up with the auth-refresh timestamp. but unclear which side initiated.
sam_runtime: quick repro in staging: 1) start a streaming generation that lasts >40s 2) call the admin rotate-token endpoint for that client id 3) our service immediately responds to the rotated token validation with 403 and closes the socket. result: client gets truncated chunk like `{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...` and then EOF (missing closing braces).

sam_runtime: sample client error: 
``` 
Error: Unexpected end of JSON input
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at parseStream (client.js:42:15)
```

alex: customer wants workaround + permanent fix. they tried catching parse errors and retrying but streaming partials break application logic.
jordan: we should short-term provide a KB workaround and a flag customers can set to avoid token rotation collision. long-term we should ensure graceful handling so rotation doesn't break active streams.
sam_runtime: short-term workaround implemented in staging: add header `x-allow-token-rotation: true` to mark sessions as immune to token rotation until stream ends. with this header our auth layer skips rotation checks for active SSE connections. can push to prod behind a feature flag.
acme_dev: that workaround worked for us in staging, thanks. would like a formal fix though.
eli_sre: created monitoring alert to count auth-rotation collisions (INF-2134) — firing when rotate events occur with >0 active SSEs for same client id.
sam_runtime: filing RFC: two options: (A) mark active streams trusted until completion, (B) modify token rotation to wait for active sessions to drain (with a max wait). leaning to (A) since it minimizes impact to latency. I'll draft PR today.
maya_oncall: please include metrics and a migration plan for customers who rely on immediate rotation (security-sensitive).
sam_runtime: will add opt-in header + feature flag + telemetry and then roll default to opt-out after 2 weeks.
alex: forwarding update to customer and closing immediate loop. will add KB entry with the header workaround and link to INF-2134.
ticket-bot: ticket 7892 updated — escalated to eng-runtime (INF-2134) and workaround provided.
